title: impatiens minor
intro: Impatiens minor, commonly known as the small balsam or balsam weed, is a flowering plant that belongs to the family Balsamaceae. This plant has been traditionally used to treat various health issues, including fever, rheumatism, and respiratory problems, due to its numerous health benefits. The therapeutic actions of Impatiens minor include anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antipyretic properties, which help to reduce pain, fight infections, and regulate body temperature. The bioactive constituents of this plant include glycosides, alkaloids, and phenolic compounds, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
